title: Griboyedov Park
description: Griboyedov Park by Arcada Construction: 6 residential buildings (14-16 floors) with two levels of underground parking at Griboyedov 17, Arabkir. Buildings 1-3: completion act 30.12.2024, operation permit 08.01.2026; buildings 4-6: completion act 21.08.2026. Apartments from 50.8 m², handed over with doors/windows, divided and plastered walls, levelled floors; travertine facade. All units are sold or reserved per the developer's apartment chooser.
